name: SmoothDash
description: Unlocks high FPS and reduces stutter and frame-time spikes.

fps-unlock.name: Unlock FPS
fps-unlock.description: Overrides GD's frame cap with the Target FPS below. Turn <cy>VSync off</c> in GD's graphics settings, or your monitor's refresh rate will still cap you.

target-fps.name: Target FPS
target-fps.description: Frame cap used when Unlock FPS is on. Set to 0 for uncapped. Default 120 is tuned for a Ryzen 5 7520U / Radeon 610M laptop: high enough to cut input lag, low enough that the iGPU doesn't overheat and throttle. Try 144 or 240 if your screen is faster.

timer-resolution.name: High-precision timer
timer-resolution.description: Asks Windows for a 1 ms timer so frames are spaced evenly. This is the biggest fix for micro-stutter at high FPS.

no-power-throttling.name: Disable power throttling
no-power-throttling.description: Stops Windows from putting GD on slow 'efficiency' CPU cores or lowering its clock speed, which causes random lag spikes on laptops and newer Intel CPUs.

high-priority.name: Above-normal priority
high-priority.description: Gives GD a higher CPU priority than background apps. Can help if things like Discord or browsers cause spikes.

particle-percent.name: Particle amount (%)
particle-percent.description: Caps how many particles each emitter can have. Lower this on heavy levels if they lag. 100 = unchanged.

force-low-detail.name: Force Low Detail Mode
force-low-detail.description: Turns on Low Detail Mode for every level that supports it (removes glow and extra decoration). Huge FPS boost on integrated graphics.

disable-shake.name: Disable shake
disable-shake.description: Turns off screen shake effects in levels. Shake forces extra redraws that cause spikes on weak GPUs.
